# dacode-dm-csv-006

## Instruction
Identify which products are frequently purchased together in the same order. Specifically, find the different product pairs and calculate the number of times they are purchased together. Record the information for the top two product pairs with the highest co-purchase count. The column names should be 'product_a' for the first product in the pair, 'product_b' for the second product, and 'co_purchase_count' for the number of times the two products are purchased together. Ensure product names follow the format 'Heller Shagamaw Frame - 2016'.
